title: Johanius Barleou
summary: Clear the hostile camp to progress Johanius's family rescue.
overview: Clear the hostile camp to progress Johanius's family rescue.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Defeat the camp's enemies rather than dragging them outside the area.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: Loading the rescue encounter creates Aellana Barleou and Lyrra Rutledge.
The controller watches the designated enemy types whose original spawn points belong to the camp.
Once none remain, it signals Johanius to continue. Pulling them away does not count as clearing the camp.

notes: Approval E348. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
Johanius dialogue, transformation and later Slayer follow-up require a fuller publication review beyond the camp controller.
